title: LIFEPUNCH Banker three-tier config contract
description: PROPOSED documentation stub for Issue #140. This groups tier-owned values; it is not one runtime payload.

t1ServerEngine.description: Per-server engine config; changes activate on the next restart.

MoneyCooldown.description: PROPOSED seconds between Banker deposit or withdrawal money operations. Existing DXRP T1 key.

t2Gamemode.description: Per-gamemode values; changes activate after Save + Sync Servers.

dailyTransferVolumeCap.description: PROPOSED maximum cash transferred by one player per day.

bankerJobSalary.description: PROPOSED value for the existing jobs[].salary field. Issue #138 owns the job row.

configOverride.description: Optional T2 per-entry override using the same field names as the T3 defaults.

t3AddonDefaults.description: Shipped Banker defaults inherited until overridden by T2.

transferFacilitationFeePercent.description: PROPOSED percentage fee. Fee destination remains unruled.

minDepositAmount.description: PROPOSED minimum cash deposit per transaction.

maxDepositAmount.description: PROPOSED maximum cash deposit per transaction.

vaultBalanceCapPerPlayer.description: PROPOSED maximum cash held for one player.
